data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 清晨洗衣间的小帮忙
data.description: 清晨的洗衣间里，纱雾穿薄荷色抓绒连帽衫和藏蓝家居长裤，站在洗衣机旁确认洗涤设置。一手轻按控制键，另一手将刚漂洗好的衬衫袖口提离机门，认真避免布料再次沾到水。窗边晨光照出门封上细小的水珠。
data.action: 一手确认洗衣机设置，另一手把湿衬衫袖口提离机门。
data.lighting: soft dawn window light on the machine door and damp shirt cuff
data.camera: medium shot, washing-machine controls and hands visible
data.promptProse: Sagiri checks the washing-machine setting with one hand while lifting a rinsed shirt cuff clear of the door with the other. Soft dawn light from the laundry-room window catches the droplets on the rubber seal.
data.animaCaption: One hand checks the machine controls while the other lifts the damp cuff clear of the door.
